name: Radha Ballavi
instructions: 1. Grind the soaked moong dal into a coarse paste with ginger and green chilies.
2. Sauté the paste in a pan with ghee, hing, cumin, fennel, sugar, and salt until it becomes a dry, non-sticky mixture.
3. Prepare a soft, pliable dough using flour, a pinch of salt, and a little oil.
4. Roll out small portions of dough, place a teaspoon of the dal stuffing in the center, and seal the edges tightly.
5. Gently roll the stuffed balls into flat discs, ensuring the filling does not leak.
6. Deep fry in hot oil until both sides are golden brown and puffed up.
description: Radha Ballavi is a classic Bengali breakfast staple, often prepared during festivals and special occasions. It is essentially a richer, more flavorful version of the standard dal puri, deeply rooted in the culinary tradition of Bengal's aristocratic households and street-food culture.
